strongest_historical_realizations.decisive_finding: Native affine-2bit = 31.5 TPS vs external mlx = 37.7 TPS on the SAME representation, and native affine-2bit (10.1GB) ~= our q3 (11.7GB, 30 TPS). PROVEN END-TO-END: the external's ~1.2x speed advantage is RUNTIME/KERNEL efficiency (mlx affine2 GEMV + dispatch/fusion), NOT the representation. Our runtime is not bandwidth-limited the way fewer bytes would need -- kernel/dispatch efficiency dominates.

recoverability.verdict: RECOVERABLE BY REPRODUCTION, NOT PRESENT. Every measurement, hash, command line and finding survives in receipts/; only the weight bytes and the compiled binary are gone, and both are reproducible from sources that still exist.

the_true_P0_parent.why: It is the direct parent of the model in production: the Q5_K GGUF that HCLI runs is a quantisation of this repo. PocketAiHub/Qwen3.8-27B-Abliterated-MLX, used by the 2026-08-18 campaign, is a DIFFERENT abliteration (layers 24-63 vs first-15-retained) and therefore a different model.

measured_today_for_comparison.note: Today's numbers are on the Q5_K GGUF and a lineage-matched MLX 4-bit, both huihui-ai. They are NOT directly comparable to the 2026-08-18 native-runtime numbers, which were a different artifact family at different BPW on a different runtime. Recorded here so the gap is visible, not so the numbers are equated.
measured_today_for_comparison.reading: Today's MLX 4-bit at 35.51 tok/s sits between the historical native q4 (33.10) and the historical external MLX affine-2bit (37.7), which is where a 4.5 BPW MLX artifact should sit. The bootstrap llama.cpp Q5_K at 24.05 is the outlier — it is the slowest realization of this model family measured on this machine, and it is what production has been running.

bandwidth_wall_carried_forward.claim: Dense full-activation single-stream decode at the 3.3448 BPW coherent floor is bandwidth-walled at ~70 TPS (M3 Ultra peak) / ~40 TPS (current effective). 100 TPS is NOT reachable by kernel tuning alone at coherent density.

activation sparsity in SwiGLU MLP (67% of active bytes): skip near-zero gated neurons
